rows.notes:
Staff credits; one segment per credit block, line count and order kept; each leading U+3000 -> 2 ASCII spaces; cast lines padded to a 16-char name column. Character names from the glossary short forms (Karcus per the slice glossary; full glossary short entry says Kurks -- conflict; [jp] -> Joldy per glossary Joldy Vorder; [jp] -> Master Asia per project decision, glossary says Undefeated of the East; [jp] -> Kira; [jp] -> You; [jp] -> Dr. Amano; [jp] -> Samarin; [jp] -> Mr. Eji; Ronin Warriors cast as '<Name> of <Armor>'). Series titles use the English titles used in the glossary 'series' field (Kikou Busou G-Breaker, Round Vernian Vifam, Wild Knights Gulkeeva, Saikyo Robo Daioja, Mama wa Shougaku 4-nensei, Ronin Warriors); [jp] title written 'Genki Bakuhatsu Gambaruger' to match the glossary machine spelling (Wikipedia title: Ganbaruger). [jp] (source typo for [jp]) -> Armored Trooper VOTOMS. 0083 and [jp] kept as written (no subtitle / no 'Mobile Suit Gundam:' prefix). Seg 48: note that the Japanese order (gojuon) no longer looks alphabetical in English. Seg 2/3: both [jp] and [jp](sic)[jp] come out as 'Executive Producer'. Song title 'Promise ~[jp]~' translated 'Promise ~A Vow to the Future~'. [jp] romanized 'Atelier Sai' (reading not verified; could be 'Atelier Aya'). [jp] -> 'M.I.', [jp] -> 'Shinanobi', [jp] -> 'Musashino Advertising' (official form not verified). Seg 78 keeps its spaces-only separator line (10 spaces).
